directory.noAssignments: No role assignments. Assign this person to a canon workforce role on a project.
directory.noMatch: No one matches that name. Clear the search to see everyone.
directory.empty: No members yet. Invite people from Members settings.
directory.caption: People
directory.seatsTitle: {seats, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} in use · {field, plural, one {# Field member} other {# Field members}}
directory.seatsBody: Seats count members above Field. Field members are metered separately on your plan.

assignments.basisHelp: Ratio uses the canon staffing ratio, Fixed a fixed count per tier; otherwise declare it.
assignments.cancelReason: No longer needed in this role.

roles.assigned: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody assigned} one {# assigned} other {# assigned}}
roles.noAnswer: No answer: the role has no canon ratio
roles.calcHelp: Headcount each ratio role needs for {occupancy} guests, from the canon staffing ratios. Roles without a ratio have no answer.
roles.intro: The 61 canon workforce roles with their staffing ratios. Enter an occupancy to see the headcount each ratio role needs.
roles.caption: Canon workforce roles

requisitions.title: {count} × {role}
requisitions.approveHelp: Approval runs your spend authority for requisitions. Above the dual threshold a second approver finishes it.
requisitions.headcountHelp: Use the staffing calculator in Roles to size ratio roles from the occupancy.
requisitions.termsHelp: Combinations come from the canon Labor Rate Card.
requisitions.unitsHelp: Hours or days each person works, in the pay basis. Leave blank while unknown; the estimate stays unpriced.
requisitions.emptyWriter: No requisitions yet. Request staff for a canon role, or size it from the occupancy in Roles.
requisitions.emptyReader: No requisitions yet. Requisitions for staff appear here once requested.
requisitions.caption: Requisitions
requisitions.secondApprover: Your approval is recorded. This requisition is above the dual approval threshold, so a second approver finishes it.

offers.title: {name} · {opportunity}
offers.empty: No offers yet. Offers are made from applications in the Opportunities pipeline.
offers.caption: Offers

agreements.onceBody: Send the link and the access code to the signer through separate channels. They are stored only as hashes and cannot be shown again; recall and resend to issue new ones.
agreements.signHelp: You are the signer. Read the full text below, then type your name to sign it.
agreements.recallHelp: The signing link stops working at once. Edit the text and send it again.
agreements.supersedeHelp: A signed agreement is never revoked or unsigned. Superseding keeps it as signed and marks that a newer agreement replaces it.
agreements.permanentBody: The signed text, the typed name and the time never change. Text fingerprint (SHA-256): {hash}
agreements.signerHelp: The person who signs. External parties sign through engagements in Opportunities.
agreements.textHelp: The full text the signer reads and signs. It can change only while the agreement is a draft.
agreements.emptyWriter: No agreements yet. Draft an offer letter, contractor agreement, MSA or NDA and send it for signature.
agreements.emptyReader: No agreements yet. Agreements you are asked to sign appear here.
agreements.caption: Agreements
agreements.notSigned: The agreement was not signed: it is no longer waiting for signature or its text changed. Reload and read it again.

certs.title: {name} · {certification}
certs.removeHelp: It leaves the person's record and no longer qualifies them. Record it again if it was removed in error.
certs.holderHelp: You cannot record your own certificate; someone else verifies it.
certs.expiresHelp: Leave blank when the certificate does not expire.
certs.emptyNoTypes: No certifications tracked yet. Add the certifications your crew need, such as rigging or first aid.
certs.emptyWriter: No certificates recorded yet. Record the certificates people hold, with their expiry.
certs.emptyReader: No certificates recorded yet. A verifier records them from evidence.
certs.caption: Certificates
certs.expiringTitle: {count, plural, one {# certificate needs} other {# certificates need}} renewal
certs.expiringBody: Expired certificates no longer qualify people for shifts that need them. Record the renewed certificate when it arrives.

errors.justification: Write why the staff are needed, up to 2,000 characters.
errors.units: Units per person is a number above zero.
errors.signedName: Type your full name to sign.
